selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does worship help belief become in a believer’s life?
questions.answer: It helps belief become deeply rooted in the person’s character.

questions.question: What can happen to ideas of faith in the mind and heart if they are not supported by worship?
questions.answer: They stay weak and have little effect.

questions.question: What two parts of worship are mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Doing what Allah commands and staying away from what He forbids.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the condition of the Muslim world today?
questions.answer: It is presented as evidence that faith becomes weak when worship is neglected.

questions.question: In which two realms is worship described as a cause of happiness?
questions.answer: In this life and in the next life.

questions.question: Besides happiness, what does worship help bring to both individuals and communities?
questions.answer: It helps bring order, success, and growth.

questions.question: How is the relationship created by worship described?
questions.answer: It is described as a noble and honored connection between the Creator and His servant.

questions.question: What does the passage say will come next after this introduction?
questions.answer: It says several reasons will be given for why worship brings happiness and prosperity in this world.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.answer: Worship strengthens faith and brings goodness and order in this life and the next.

questions.question: How does worship affect matters connected to conscience and reason?
questions.answer: It nourishes and strengthens them.

questions.question: What weakness appears if worship is missing?
questions.answer: A person’s faith-related understanding does not become strong or active.

questions.question: Which actions show worship according to the passage?
questions.answer: Obeying Allah’s commands and avoiding His prohibitions.

questions.question: What proof from real life is mentioned for this teaching?
questions.answer: The present condition of the Islamic world.

questions.question: In what way does worship help life “here and there”?
questions.answer: It helps organize life in this world and in the hereafter.

questions.question: Does the passage present worship as only personal, or also social?
questions.answer: It presents worship as both personal and social.

questions.question: How is the servant’s connection to the Creator described through worship?
questions.answer: It is described as elevated, respected, and meaningful.

questions.question: According to the passage, what gives power to beliefs so they are not just ideas?
questions.answer: Worship gives them strength and makes them effective.

questions.question: Why are conscience and reason not enough by themselves?
questions.answer: Without worship, they are not strengthened enough to have full effect.

questions.question: What does abstaining from prohibitions mean in simple words?
questions.answer: It means staying away from what Allah has forbidden.

questions.question: What kinds of well-being are connected to worship?
questions.answer: Happiness, proper order, achievement, and growth.

questions.question: Who benefits from worship according to the passage: only one person or whole groups too?
questions.answer: Both one person and whole communities benefit.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the status of the bond created by worship?
questions.answer: It is a high and honored bond.

questions.question: What kind of relationship does worship create between a human being and Allah?
questions.answer: A dignified relationship between the servant and the Creator.

questions.question: What does worship do to the principles of faith inside a believer?
questions.answer: It plants them firmly so they become part of who the person is.
